sentence: Every balledgeable mouth has buried a wombo it was never asked to speak.

wombos.definition: A portmanteau — a word created by blending two or more existing words together. The foundational term for all of Professor Sendy's coined blended vocabulary.
wombos.example: 'Brunch' is technically a wombo — breakfast plus lunch.

wombos.definition: Possessing a deep, specialized knowledge about something; highly informed in a particular area of passion or expertise.
wombos.example: He's so balledgeable he could teach a masterclass on the subject.
